articles.passage:
Today was one of those days where I barely had a moment to catch my breath. My morning kicked off with our weekly review session with Changhong Jihua — it's a recurring meeting where we go over the progress on our public cloud and AI collaboration. We spent two solid hours aligning on pipeline updates and figuring out how to push a few deals forward. I had to walk them through some new product capabilities, which honestly felt like I was juggling three conversations at once.

After a quick lunch, I hopped into another meeting about our shrimp-selling initiative. I know it sounds bizarre, but Tencent Cloud is actually running a campaign to help partners tap into the crayfish supply chain. We brainstormed ways to onboard more sellers and streamline the logistics. Then I wrapped up the day with a training session on the same topic, this time focused on the nitty-gritty of how to pack and farm crayfish digitally. It's definitely not what I imagined I'd be doing when I joined the ecosystem team, but hey, that's what keeps the job interesting.

expressions.example: After three back-to-back calls, I finally caught my breath around 3 PM.
We'll kick off the new quarter with a strategy workshop next Monday.
Let's align on the timeline before looping in the client.

expressions.zh: 带某人过一遍，详细解释
expressions.example: Can you walk me through the pricing model one more time?
I need to hop into a quick sync with the product team.
Our biggest client this quarter is — wait for it — a crayfish farm.
Let's skip the overview and get into the nitty-gritty.
We're looking to tap into the Southeast Asian market next year.

articles.speakingTip: 今天重点练习语调起伏。注意 "wait for it" 和 "I know it sounds bizarre" 这类插入语，说的时候要自然地降低音量、放慢语速，制造 conversational 的节奏感。不要像读课文一样平铺直叙。
